# 868. Binary Gap

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def binaryGap(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 0
        prev_loc = None
        cur_loc = 0
        while n:
            if n % 2 == 1:
                if prev_loc is not None:
                    ans = max(ans, cur_loc - prev_loc)
                prev_loc = cur_loc
            n = n // 2
            cur_loc += 1
        return ans
```
